auto.weReOnAMission_4ad6: We're on a mission to transform how fashion designers and brands manage their business, connect with clients, and scale their operations, built by people who understand your challenges.
auto.bornInsideARealFashion_6f1a: Born inside a real fashion studio.
auto.fashionTallyWasBornFrom_e51c: Fashion Tally was born from the real, everyday challenges inside the African fashion industry: challenges that founder
auto.personallyExperiencedWhileRunnin_3ef2: personally experienced while running her own fashion brand,
auto.forYearsMaimunaManagedClient_1241: For years, Maimuna managed client measurements in notebooks, tracked orders through scattered WhatsApp messages, monitored inventory manually, and handled finances using spreadsheets that rarely reflected the reality of production. She understood the stress of missing measurements, losing client details, delayed fittings, and the difficulty of staying consistent as the brand grew.
auto.sheAlsoRealisedThatThousands_a934: She also realised that thousands of designers across Africa faced the same problems, not because of a lack of talent, but because of a lack of the right tools. Existing software was often too complex, too expensive, or not built around how fashion designers actually work.
auto.thisInspiredFashionTallyA_7cb9: This inspired Fashion Tally, a platform built with a deep understanding of how African fashion businesses operate. Every feature, from client management and measurements to invoicing, appointments, inventory and CRM, is shaped by real industry pain points and tested with real designers.
auto.theGoalIsSimpleBut_3b31: The goal is simple but powerful: to bring structure, professionalism and digital growth to fashion entrepreneurs, so they can run their businesses with confidence and clarity.
auto.fashionTallyIsMoreThan_8f25: “Fashion Tally is more than software. It is a digital partner designed to help African designers stay organised, save time, scale with ease, and grow into global fashion brands.”
